result:
Migration authored, no DDL executed against any database.

## Report

**File:** `supabase/migrations/20260816020000_c2_cron_app_config.sql`

**Repo evidence:**
- `supabase/migrations/20260519211000_phase_2_change_detection_job.sql`, `20260519221000_phase_3_refresh_cron.sql`, `20260519230000_phase_6_deadline_reminders.sql` — the three `cron.schedule(...)` jobs (`forms-change-detection-weekly`, `statutes-refresh-annual`, `process-deadline-reminders`), all reading `current_setting('app.backend_url', true)` and (two of them) `current_setting('app.api_key', true)`.
- Grep across `supabase/` and `backend/` found **no migration or code that ever sets those GUCs** (no `ALTER DATABASE/ROLE ... SET app.*`) — confirmed independently, matching an existing diagnosis already in the repo at `runs/13_s2_5_diagnose/REPORT.md`, which documents this exact dead-GUC/unread-table mismatch and recommends fix option (ii): amend the cron SQL to read `app_config` instead.
- `supabase/migrations/20260814000000_add_app_config.sql` — the canonical `app_config(key text primary key, value text)` table, whose own header comment says it holds `backend_url`/`api_key` "read by the reminder cron" — confirming the intended keys.
- `backend/src/api/routers/reminders.py` — confirms `/api/reminders/process` is the hourly-cron-called endpoint (used to double-check the phase 6 URL path).

**What the migration does:**
1. Seeds `app_config` rows `backend_url` and `api_key` as empty placeholders (`on conflict do nothing`), consistent with the table's stated convention that real values are deployment-specific and set outside migrations.
2. Re-issues all three `cron.schedule(...)` calls with the same job names (so `cron.schedule` updates the existing jobs in place) but rewrites their SQL bodies to pull `url`/`X-API-Key` from `app_config` via subqueries instead of `current_setting(...)`.

**Could not discover:** no real `backend_url`/`api_key` values exist anywhere in the repo (by design — they're deployment secrets set in Supabase directly). The seeded rows are empty strings; Joe must populate them in Supabase before these jobs produce anything but no-op posts to `'' || '/api/...'`. I did not invent placeholder-looking real values.

**Not done (out of scope per task):** did not touch Phase 1's two retention jobs (`purge-document-text-30d`, `purge-guest-sessions-72h`) — they contain no GUC reads, only plain SQL, so no amendment applies.
